Eye Pattern - Alien Compound Eyes.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Alien Compound Eyes
Eyes with a faceted, multi-lensed appearance — insectoid or alien compound-eye structures replacing standard irises.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Alien Compound Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both eyes are alien compound structures — multifaceted and iridescent, with no conventional iris or pupil, reflecting light in fractured prismatic patterns. Apply alien compound eye structure using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
